⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

- names `complex.zod.ts` → `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` — edited by this change

  > **Breaking, deliberately.** `KanbanColumn` declared its card list as `items` in `complex.ts` and in the zod mirror `complex.zod.ts`. Every board reads `cards`. - names `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` → `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` — edited by this change

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

### ① Derived judgments

**Right.**

1. **Accept-set narrowing (runtime).** `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` → `normalizeFilterOptions`: a `globalFilters[].options[]` member that is not an object (string, number, boolean) used to be lifted to `{ value: String(o), label: String(o) }` and now yields no option — a shorthand-only filter resolves with `options` undefined, a mixed array keeps only its object members. The nullish and value-less skips are unchanged. The runtime now reads the document exactly as `GlobalFilterSchema` does: one strict contract, no renderer dialect beside it (objectui AGENTS.md #0.1). This is the end state the rulings named — 「7917 ②」 (2026-08-12) and 「objectstack#7917 不考虑现有数据」 (2026-09-02, director release `5511028727`). No lift, alias, fallback or migration is added. RIGHT.
2. **Whole arm, not the string case.** Numbers and booleans, which Phase 1 also lifted through `String(o)`, are dropped too and pinned (`drops EVERY non-object member`); the warning spells `"42"` and `42` distinguishably. They were never spec-valid. RIGHT.
3. **Public export surface of `@object-ui/core` unchanged.** `packages/core/src/index.ts` re-exports `./utils/dashboard-filters.js`; the module's `export` lines are identical between base and head (`DashboardFilterDef`, `DateRangeValue`, `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS`, `resetDashboardFilterWarnings`, `resolveDashboardFilterDefs`, `dashboardFilterVariableDefs`, `buildFilterCondition`, `buildWidgetScopedFilter`). `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` keeps a job — the memo it clears now dedupes the dropped-member warning — so the dispatch's conditional ("if it retires with its memo") resolved to "stays", and the changeset says so. No signature moved; `normalizeFilterOptions` is module-private. RIGHT.
4. **The skip is audible, at the right level, and is not a fallback.** `warnDroppedShorthandOptions`: dev-mode, once per filter per session (same memo key discipline as Phase 1), names the filter, the dropped members and the `{ value, label }` rewrite, and promises no lift — the negative pin `not.toContain('lifted here')` guards the sentence. Governing text supports it: objectstack AGENTS.md "Degradation log levels" puts a functional degradation (a visibly emptier select) at `warn` and says "when you must fall back, say what was lost"; ADR-0078 §4 asks the runtime seam to emit a dev-mode diagnostic where it skips rather than swallow it. A diagnostic is not a lenient fallback, so #0.1 is intact. RIGHT.
5. **`@object-ui/types`.** `GlobalFilterSchema` JSDoc corrected in place; the schema itself is untouched, so the emitted declaration changes in comment text only. The `{ preset }` alias (`liftLegacyGlobalFilterDefault`) is left on its own retirement window and the docblock now says so. RIGHT.
6. **Docs callout** (`content/docs/guide/dashboard-filters.md`) flipped from "Deprecated … still lifted" to "Not accepted … no longer lifts … yields no option … rewrite". No fenced block changed. RIGHT.
7. **Pins.** Five DROP pins reported red-first against the untouched source and green after; the once-memo, different-filter, canonical-silence (honestly labelled vacuous) and reset pins are retained. The diff matches the report. RIGHT.

**Wrong.**

- **W1 — a shipped README still promises the lift (verdict-carrying).** `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`, the `globalFilters` example's `options` comment, at the head: 「The bare-string shorthand (["EMEA", …]) is deprecated: a STORED one is still lifted at runtime, and warns (objectui#4356).」 `README.md` is in that package's `files`, so it ships in the npm tarball and is the package page. This diff makes the sentence false and leaves the file untouched (byte-identical to `main`). It is the Phase-0 teaching site the survey named (`5276031321`, then rewritten by PR #4601 to the current text) — known to this card's thread.
